headline: Lowell Center for the Arts seeks $400,000 to restore stained glass windows at 400 Merrimack Street.
summary: The work covers the first-floor windows, which would be removed, rebuilt, and fitted with protective Plexiglas. The applicant's board president said the window work costs about $850,000 in total, and the chair said the determination period is February, March. Separately, the $70,000 roof repair request for St. Joseph the Worker Shrine at 37 Lee Street was deemed eligible, and the 2027 meeting schedule was approved.
decisions: Deemed eligible the $70,000 roof repair request for the St. Joseph the Worker Shrine at 37 Lee Street.
Approved the 2027 meeting schedule as listed.
discussion: Smith Baker Center windows: Members asked how the window costs were figured and whether the city had approved the historic permits. The applicant's board president said some figures are estimates, that the window work is about $850,000, and that the city has helped with permits.

Application meeting schedule: Members discussed splitting 13 applications across several meetings, starting in December with about four per night. They also said eligibility meetings could be virtual for applicants in the next round.
Chair selection: Members asked whether a new chair must be chosen on an agenda and agreed to put the election on the December agenda.

decision_evidence.quote: I'll make a motion to deem it eligible. And I'll second. Great. All in favor? Aye. Aye. Great.
Motion to approve the schedule as [laughter] listed. ... All approved? Aye. Aye. Great.

decision_titles: $70,000 roof repair, St. Joseph the Worker Shrine
